Export locked until decided + ack; DRAFT/DO-NOT-SEND, no send path. Mask any PII/regulated data, warn without echoing.
HONEST: persistent pre-product/DRAFT/synthetic/"evidence not advice"/human-review banner; rules illustrative; report ranking/verdict stated plainly; marketing build-check; legal DRAFT "needs licensed Norwegian advokat"; no fabricated metrics.
